Solution 2 is correct. Each handshake is between one witch and one sorcerer, since witches shook only sorcerers' hands and sorcerers shook only witches' hands. Each of the 6 witches shook hands with all 10 sorcerers, giving 6 × 10 = 60 handshakes. Solution 2 reaches this count from both sides and gets 60.

Solution 1 is wrong because it counts sorcerer-to-sorcerer handshakes, which the problem rules out. Solution 3 is wrong because it halves the count after wrongly assuming each handshake was double-counted. Each handshake is counted once when counting from the witches' side.

CHOICE: 2
